transcript.content: hey, i'm berry. tell me your dream, however it comes back to you.
I was in this old hotel, in a tiny lift with the brass walls and the folding metal gate, going up with my friend Tomas from school.
a tiny lift with a folding gate, that already feels like it's from another time. what do you remember about the ride up?
It just kept going up way too long. And at some point I looked at him again and he was a kid, maybe ten, in our old school uniform. He didn't seem to notice.
he didn't seem to notice anything had changed. what did that feel like, looking over and seeing him as a kid again?
Honestly it was more weird than scary. Like I was the only one who realised we weren't adults anymore.
yeah, that quiet kind of weird — like noticing something's off but no one else is picking up on it. did you say anything to him?
No, I don't think I said anything. I just sort of watched him, and then the lift stopped.
so you just watched, and then it stopped. was there a moment while it was going up that's stayed with you most?
I think the moment I looked over and he was small again, really still, like nothing was strange. That's the part I keep seeing.
it makes sense that's the one that stays. do you remember where the lift doors opened?
Not doors — the gate opened. And it wasn't a corridor. It was this orchard, at dusk. Rows of apple trees, and all the apples glowing soft, like little lamps.
that's quite a thing to step into after that brass lift. what did you do?
I stepped out slowly, I think, just taking it in. Tomas ran off ahead between the trees.
he went from really still to running off like that. did you go after him?
No, I didn't. There was this white horse standing in the middle of the orchard, just very still. I went over to it instead.
you went over to the horse instead. what was it like standing close to it?
It lowered its head so I could touch its nose. It was warm. That felt real, more than the rest.
that warmth stays with you. what else did you notice there, about the horse or the orchard?
It was just so still, the whole place. Dusk light, rows of trees, the apples glowing. The horse just standing there breathing slowly.
i can almost feel that stillness through what you're saying. what happened after that?
When I looked back, Tomas was gone. Then I woke up.
so it ends with you looking back and him just not being there. how did that feel, right at the end?
It was that same quiet off feeling, not panic. Like it was bound to happen. Still sad, though.
still sad, though. that's real. was there anything in the dream that felt like it mattered to you, something you'd want to hold onto?
Probably the horse lowering its head. That felt like it meant something, even if I don't know what.

so you were in this old hotel, in a tiny lift with brass walls and a folding gate, going up with your friend Tomas from school. the lift kept going up way too long, and at some point you looked over and he was a kid again, maybe ten, in your old school uniform, not seeming to notice. it was more weird than scary, like only you realised you weren't adults anymore. you didn't say anything, just watched, and then the lift stopped and the gate opened onto an orchard at dusk, rows of apple trees with apples glowing like little lamps.

you stepped out slowly, Tomas ran off ahead between the trees, but you went over to a white horse standing very still in the middle. it lowered its head so you could touch its nose, and that felt real, more than the rest. the whole place was still, dusk light, the horse breathing slowly. when you looked back, Tomas was gone, and you woke up with that quiet off feeling, not panic, like it was bound to happen, still sad. and the moment with the horse lowering its head felt like it meant something.

did i get that right, or is there anything i missed?
That's it, yeah. You got it right.
would you like to see it drawn?
Yes, I would.

there are a few ways it could be drawn. i could do it like a coloured pencil drawing, where the lines hesitate a little, as if remembering how to draw.

or a delicate ink wash, where the line feels fragile, like a held breath.

or an oil painting with warm glazes, built up in layers, like time touching the surface.

or i could make it like a photograph, quiet and still, with the kind of clarity memory sometimes has.

which of those feels closest to how you see it? or if none do, tell me your own.
The delicate ink wash one. That held-breath feeling is close.

okay, delicate ink wash it is. i'll start with the old hotel lift.

i see it as tiny, old, with warm brass walls and a folding metal gate. the light is dim and warm, like an old hotel lift's. those last bits are my guesses, but does any of it feel different to you, or should i leave it as it is?
That fits. The warm dim light and brass feel right.

i'm sketching the old hotel lift and Tomas and the white horse and the orchard now, it'll appear on the right. nothing else is being drawn yet.

and since you're in it too, i'll draw you as well. how would you like to be drawn — as you are, or however i imagine you?
However you imagine me is fine.
okay, i'll draw you as i imagine you. the sketch is coming together now, like everything else.
Okay.

the drawing is up on the right now.

does it look the way you remember?
It looks right.

i'm glad it feels right.

i'll draw the moments of the dream now, in order, each one carrying on from the one before it. they'll appear on the right as they're ready.
Okay.
the moment with you and Tomas in the tiny brass lift — does it look the way you remember?
It looks right.
that one's settled then. the others are still being drawn, they'll appear on the right as they're ready.
Alright.

this is the one you said you kept seeing — when you looked over and he was a kid again.

does it look the way you remember it?
Yes, it does.
good, that one feels right too. the rest are still being drawn, they'll show up on the right as they're ready.
Okay.
the lift gate opening onto the orchard at dusk is on the right now. does it look the way you remember?
It does, the glow on the apples is right.
glad the glow feels right. the rest of the moments are still being drawn, they'll show up on the right as they're ready.
Okay.

a new moment is up on the right now.

does it look the way you remember?
This one's right too.
good, that one's settled. the rest of the moments are still being drawn, they'll appear on the right as they're ready.
Okay.

new moments are up on the right now.

do they look the way you remember?
Yes, they look right. Especially the one with the horse.
glad those feel right, especially the horse. one more moment is still being drawn, it'll appear on the right when it's ready.
